This looks complete and correct. The screen is built at `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`, using only Strata components (`Link`, `Card`, `Checkbox`, `Select`, `Amount`, `Button`, `Alert`) and tokens (audit score 100 on both files, no raw colors/pixels, logical properties throughout).

Summary of what it does:
- **Back link** with an arrow icon (`IconArrowLeft`) back to the order.
- **Order items list**: each row shows a checkbox with the item name, quantity, and line price (`Amount`); selecting an item reveals a **Reason** `Select` (5 grocery-relevant reasons).
- **Refund total** recalculates live via `useMemo` over selected items' price × quantity, shown as a hero `Amount`.
- **Submit** button is disabled until at least one item is selected and every selected item has a reason; submitting shows a success `Alert`.
- All copy is in English but uses no hardcoded direction/brand logic, so it will render correctly in the Arabic/RTL locale via `ThemeScope`.
